docket_entries.description: REPLY BRIEF IN SUPPORT OF SPECIAL MOTION TO STRIKE PLAINTIFF'S COMPLAINT PURSUANT TO CCP 425.16 AND REQUEST FOR AWARD OF COSTS AND FEES FILED BY DEFENDANT DORE, ALEXANDER AN INDIVIDUAL ZHU, LIN

REPLY DECLARATION OF JAMES MEISTER IN SUPPORT OF SPECIAL MOTION TO STRIKE PLAINTIFF'S COMPLAINT PURSUANT TO CCP 425.16 AND REQUEST FOR AWARD OF COSTS AND FEES FILED BY DEFENDANT DORE, ALEXANDER AN INDIVIDUAL ZHU, LIN
MINI-MINUTES FOR MAR-24-2010 9:30 AM FOR DEPT 301

LAW AND MOTION 301, ARGUED; THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANTS ALEXANDER DORE AND LIN ZHU'S SPECIAL MOTION TO STRIKE PLAINTIFF'S COMPLAINT PURSUANT TO CCP 425.16 AND REQUEST FOR AWARD OF COSTS AND ATTORNEY'S FEES IS DENIED. DEFENDANT HAS SHIFTED THE BURDEN TO PLAINTIFF BY SHOWING THAT THE COMPLAINT ARISES IN SUBSTANTIAL PART FROM CONDUCT PROTECTED UNDER CCP SECTION 425.16(E)(2). PLAINTIFF, HOWEVER HAS ALSO CLAIMED RELIEF BASED ON UNPROTECTED COMMUNICATIONS WITH THIRD PARTIES AND HAS PRESENTED SUFFICIENT EVIDENCE TO SHOW A PRIMA FACIE CASE OF SUCCESS ON THE MERITS THROUGH THE DECLARATIONS OF PEHLIVAN, DE LEON AND THOMPSON, EVEN ASSUMING THAT THE OCTOBER 22 LETTER IS ABSOLUTELY PRIVILEGED. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR #8189
